scientific_question: At the same twelve fitted parameters and the same 13A+1A-transpose non-anchor budget as v164.1, can pure non-affine cross-coordinate transport preserve sparse-view temporal gradients where global affine transport failed?
role: result-blind, post-open controlled virtual-BOST mechanism diagnostic; no v165 scientific arrays may be read before this contract and its implementation closure are committed
physical_hypothesis: The remaining five-camera temporal gradient tail may be caused by local bending or twisting that a global affine map cannot express. Pure xy, xz, yz, and xyz displacement modes can move different parts of the field in different directions without reintroducing translation, rotation, scale, or shear.

new_data_boundary.senior_instruction: generate two-component 2D displacement fields from the executable 3D density field and camera positions
new_data_boundary.historical_pairing_status: the old real 2D-to-3D correspondence is unavailable and is not inferred
new_data_boundary.claim_boundary: all v165 observations are simulated by the frozen straight-ray BOS proxy; real_bost remains false

frozen_predecessor.closed_family: twelve-parameter global affine transport fitted from deployment-visible observation innovation

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the reconstructed density field; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component observations are generated by code for the controlled virtual proxy; no true experiment pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior, inherited unchanged from v164.1

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157-v164.1
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v164.1
inputs.calibration_root_contract: the corrected package_v2 unpacked data root previously bound by v164.1, not a copied directory containing the same camera JSON files

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.initial_anchor: at t=0 use the frozen isotropic H1 fixed-0.03 reconstruction because no previous deployed state exists
representation.normalized_coordinates: sx, sy, and sz map each frozen world-axis interval affinely to [-1,1]
representation.pure_non_affine_generator: for each displacement output axis use exactly four scalar modes [sx*sy, sx*sz, sy*sz, sx*sy*sz], multiplied by the minimum field-grid spacing; concatenate the three output blocks in x,y,z order for exactly twelve dimensionless parameters
representation.affine_exclusion: constant, sx, sy, and sz scalar modes are forbidden; no translation or linear affine displacement can be represented by the primary basis on the symmetric tensor grid
representation.observation_fit: form the twelve first-order pullback tangents -h_min*partial_i(rho_previous)*phi_j, project each through the current reported-geometry operator, and fit the current observation innovation with column-normalized minimum-norm SVD
representation.exact_transport: after one scalar cap, evaluate u(x) from the same cross modes and pull back rho_previous at x-u(x) using trilinear interpolation with zero outside the frozen box
representation.maximum_corner_displacement: h_min*(t_i-t_(i-1))/0.25; one minimum-grid cell per reference time step
representation.jacobian_cap: the displacement-Jacobian spectral norm is at most 0.5; because the cross-mode Jacobian is separately affine in each normalized coordinate, its spectral-norm maximum is attained at a cube corner
representation.cap_scaling: multiply all twelve fitted parameters once by min(1, displacement_cap/raw_corner_displacement, 0.5/raw_corner_jacobian_norm); no component clipping, refit, or line search
representation.diffeomorphism_certificate: the source map x-u(x) has a strictly positive determinant; the reported conservative determinant lower bound is (1-max_corner_jacobian_norm)^3
representation.current_solve: project the transported prior into the same DCT subspace and solve (G+alpha*H)c=q+alpha*H*c_transport with frozen isotropic H1 and alpha=0.03*median_positive_generalized_eigenvalue
representation.no_transport_control: the same causal centered-H1 recurrence using the previous control coefficients directly, with no cross-term fit or warp
representation.previous_state: the immediately previous reconstruction of the same arm, model, calibration, and active-camera set; never truth or a separately selected candidate
representation.permutation_contract: camera-row reordering leaves G, q, fitted cross-term parameters, transported prior, and reconstructed coefficients unchanged within frozen tolerances
representation.variable_cardinality: the same mechanism is rebuilt independently for the fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no affine modes, future frame, bidirectional smoothing, truth state, reset, fallback, component clipping, alternative cross modes, alternative SVD cutoff, post-result cap, learned transition, alternative anchor, per-sample selector, or post-result multiplier

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count

cross-term SVD rank, condition, linearized residual ratio, cap activity, corner displacement, Jacobian spectral norm, determinant certificate, centered-H1 stationarity, and camera-permutation difference

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; all camera subsets, models, times, and arms reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact A-transpose equivalent for current q, twelve exact current-geometry forward actions on cross-term tangent fields, and one exact A equivalent for the final current projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path
independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy multidimensional inverse-DCT basis construction
independent_recomputation.cross_term_fit: independently build the four normalized cross features, finite-difference tangents, gesvd fit, scalar caps, explicit x-u(x) source coordinates, and a separately coded trilinear interpolator
independent_recomputation.solver: use independent generalized eigendecomposition and direct spectral centered-H1 reconstruction; do not import formal transport or centered-solver helpers
independent_recomputation.sequence: rebuild every model-calibration-camera sequence in ordered time using only independently generated observations and the prior independent arm state
required_comparisons: all 1404 formal and independent primary coefficient vectors
all 1404 cross-term parameter vectors and transported-prior coefficient vectors
current-run H1 and CGLS rows and summaries reconstructed independently and compared to v164.1

decision_order: Any input-root, parent-evidence, source-semantics, operator, basis, sequence, density, rank, linearized-fit, displacement-cap, Jacobian-cap, diffeomorphism, stationarity, residual, accounting, current-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v165 inconclusive.

Only the frozen twelve pure cross-coordinate modes with the fixed SVD cutoff, scalar caps, pullback interpolation, H1 multiplier 0.03, and causal recurrence are primary; affine modes or alternative local modes may not replace them after results.

The primary passes only if all twelve time-by-camera strata pass every absolute gate, every nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly below the frozen H1 value.
If the no-transport centered-H1 control also passes all twelve strata, cross-term transport is not credited and a predictor is not authorized from this diagnostic alone.

A valid primary failure closes only this pure xy/xz/yz/xyz cross-term family; it does not prove all local or nonrigid transport impossible and does not authorize post-result mode tuning, a larger network, or GPU rescue.

A valid primary pass with no-transport-control failure establishes only controlled virtual-BOST non-affine transport headroom and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
